targets.recommended_evidence_direction_note: Acquisition floor unmet on 2/3 seeds means the decisive discrimination criterion was never reachable; correctly self-routed. The per-seed difficulty split (1/3 solved immediately and stays solved; 2/3 never approach the floor across a 10x exposure range with no improving trend) is recorded as an informative finding even though the run itself does not weigh on MECH-472's truth value.
targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: [2026-08-03 failure autopsy, V3-EXQ-882, confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-882_2026-08-03]: FIRST experimental test of MECH-472. non_degenerate=false correctly per the claim's own pre-registered guard (acquisition floor unmet on worst seed) -- the decisive in-context/held-out gap was never reachable, so this is neither support nor weakening. Per-seed data shows a real, stable difficulty split in the 'corner' reef geometry (1/3 seeds solved immediately and stays solved; 2/3 never approach the floor across a 10x exposure range with no improving trend) -- worth recording as informative even though the run itself is non-contributory to MECH-472's own truth value. Route: /queue-experiment V3-EXQ-882a with more seeds and a fraction-based (not worst-of-3) acquisition gate; do not assume more of the same training alone resolves the hard seeds. No claim-status change; v3_pending stays as registered pending a corrected re-run.
learning_extracted: MECH-472's own non-degeneracy guard (registered 2026-07-22, before any run existed) correctly identified and prevented exactly the failure mode it was designed to catch -- a guard-worked-as-designed instance.

The 'corner' reef geometry (hazard_food_attraction=0.0) shows a stable, large per-seed difficulty split under a bare frozen-e2/REINFORCE recipe: one seed solved almost immediately, two not solved even at 10x budget with no improving trend.

This is a measurement/test-design gap in the same family as V3-EXQ-873's: a worst-of-3-seed veto is too fragile a readiness bar given real per-seed environment-difficulty variance in a freshly-minted (first-ever) competence/geometry pairing.
Whether the difficulty split reflects a genuine training-recipe ceiling or is a too-few-seeds sampling artefact is not decidable from this run alone.

Shared structural property with V3-EXQ-873 (MECH-322, unrelated claim): a worst-of-N=3-seed readiness gate lets one hard/unlucky seed veto a whole arm/run's adjudication even though clearing seeds are independently informative -- see cluster_pattern.

cluster_pattern.structural_property: A within-arm, cross-seed worst-case reduction (this driver's own worst-seed readiness computation, analogous to V3-EXQ-873's local _worst()-style helper feeding experiments/_lib/precondition_gate.py's evaluate_arm_gate) treats a naturally stochastic readiness precondition (here, per-seed environment-difficulty variance in acquisition) as if it required deterministic clearance across all N=3 seeds. One or two hard/unlucky seeds then zero the entire run's adjudication, burying informative data from the seed(s) that did clear (a stable difficulty-diagnostic split here; a clean confirming result in V3-EXQ-873). Distinct from the arm-vs-arm vacating defect precondition_gate.py already closes (V3-EXQ-785) -- that fix is cross-arm; this pattern is within-arm, cross-seed. This driver is among 55 in the corpus using precondition_gate.py, so this convention is plausibly common elsewhere.
